recommendations.title: Deploy AMR-07 & Reroute MAT-004 Replenishment
recommendations.reason: Projected +20% production surge will exceed Line A replenishment bandwidth by 28%. High risk of line stoppage on MAT-004.
actions: Deploy standby robot AMR-07 to Line A replenishment route
Elevate material MAT-004 delivery priority to CRITICAL
Enable Staging Area S2 overflow buffer for Line A components
